# Verifies golang.org/issue/37555.

[short] skip

# 'bolero test -json' should say a test passes if it says it passes.
bolero test -json ./pass
stdout '"Action":"pass","Package":"[^"]*","Elapsed":[^"]*}\n\z'
! stdout '"Test":.*\n\z'

# 'bolero test -json' should say a test passes if it exits 0 and prints nothing.
# TODO(golang.org/issue/29062): this should fail in the future.
bolero test -json ./exit0main
stdout '"Action":"pass".*\n\z'
! stdout '"Test":.*\n\z'

# 'bolero test -json' should say a test fails if it exits 1 and prints nothing.
! bolero test -json ./exit1main
stdout '"Action":"fail".*\n\z'
! stdout '"Test":.*\n\z'

# 'bolero test -json' should say a test fails if it panics.
! bolero test -json ./panic
stdout '"Action":"fail".*\n\z'
! stdout '"Test":.*\n\z'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/test

go 1.14

-- pass/pass_test.go --
package pass_test

import "testing"

func TestPass(t *testing.T) {}

-- exit0main/exit0main_test.go --
package exit0_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
	os.Exit(0)
}

-- exit1main/exit1main_test.go --
package exit1_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"
)

func TestMain(m *testing.M) {
	os.Exit(1)
}

-- panic/panic_test.go --
package panic_test

import "testing"

func TestPanic(t *testing.T) {
	panic("oh no")
}
